// diagnostic

E0960

module contribution names a non-reserved namespace (U3: `env`/`system`/`image`)

What

module contribution names a non-reserved namespace (U3: `env`/`system`/`image`)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0960

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0960: tests/ui/module_unknown_namespace.stderr.

Error [E0960]: `settings` is not a module namespace
  --> tests/ui/module_unknown_namespace.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     settings.dev: Env {
    |     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: a module contributes to the reserved namespaces `env` (a dev environment), `system` (a whole machine), `image` (a disk image), `fleet` (a host fleet), `vmtest` (a VM test), and `profile` (a package generation)
 Fix: begin the contribution with `env`, `system`, `image`, `fleet`, `vmtest`, or `profile`
